rows.acip: ZLA BA GNYIS PA LA SROG 'DZIN RAGS PA LAS THUR SEL GYI RLUNG SKYE, DE'I TSE SEMS CAN DE'I LUS 'BUR PO LNGA DOD PA RUS SBAL LTA BU,
rows.wylie: zla ba gnyis pa la srog 'dzin rags pa las thur sel gyi rlung skye, de'i tshe sems can de'i lus 'bur po lnga dod pa rus sbal lta bu
rows.english: In the second month, this gross form of the life-holding wind triggers the downward-clearing wind. At this point, five small protuberances have come forth from the body, so that it resembles a turtle.

rows.acip: DE DANG MTSUNGS PAR ZLA BA DANG PO LA DBUS SBOM ZHING MTHA' GNYIS PHRA BA NYA'I DBYIBS LTA BU, GNYIS PA LA MGO DANG YAN LAG THON PAR 'BUR PO RE DOD PAS RUS SBAL LTA BU'O, ,GSUM PA LA MGO'I THAD RGYAS NAS ZE SGUR PHAG RGOD LTA BU,
rows.wylie: de dang mtshungs par zla ba dang po la dbus sbom zhing mtha' gnyis phra ba nya'i dbyibs lta bu, gnyis pa la mgo dang yan lag thon par 'bur po re dod pas rus sbal lta bu'o, ,gsum pa la mgo'i thad rgyas nas ze sgur phag rgod lta bu
rows.english: The stages in the womb then are the same.  In the first month, the middle of the fetus is relatively thick, and the two ends taper off, in the way that the body of a fish does.  In the second month, protuberances that will become the head and the limbs start to stick out, so that the fetus resembles a turtle.  In the third month, the area around the head thickens and takes on a tubelike shape, like the snout of a boar.
